title: NCERT Grade 8 Mathematics | Fractions as Percentages
text:
Fractions as Percentages

Key terms: fraction, percentage, denominator

Percentages are fractions with a denominator of 100. To express a fraction as a percentage, multiply the fraction by 100.

metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Fractions as Percentages in Grade 8 Mathematics.

title: NCERT Grade 8 Mathematics | Expressing Fractions as Percentages
text:

To express a fraction as a percentage, find its equivalent fraction with 100 as the denominator or multiply the fraction by 100.

metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Expressing Fractions as Percentages in Grade 8 Mathematics.

title: NCERT Grade 8 Mathematics | Percentage of Some Quantity
text:

To find 'x%' of a quantity 'y', multiply x/100 by y. This is the same as finding x/100 of y.

metadata.subject: Mathematics
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Percentage of Some Quantity in Grade 8 Mathematics.

title: NCERT Grade 8 Mathematics | Comparing Percentages
text:

title: NCERT Grade 8 Mathematics | Percentages Greater than 100
text:

metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Percentages Greater than 100 in Grade 8 Mathematics.

title: NCERT Grade 8 Mathematics | Percentages Greater than 100
text:

metadata.subject: Mathematics
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to remember concepts related to Percentages Greater than 100 in Grade 8 Mathematics.

title: NCERT Grade 8 Mathematics | Fractions in Disguise
text:

metadata.subject: Mathematics
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Fractions in Disguise in Grade 8 Mathematics.

title: NCERT Grade 8 Mathematics | Comparing Proportions using Percentages
